visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The camera looks out of a car's side window. In the foreground, a stack of white panels is secured with yellow straps, with black sandals and a white bottle placed on top. Beyond the grassy curb, a wide green field stretches towards several massive, white high-rise apartment towers under a bright, partly cloudy blue sky. (2) As the vehicle moves forward, a dark green utility pole passes the frame. A large black square of fabric, resembling a sail, is visible in the middle of the overgrown field. A black cylindrical water tank sits partially hidden by tall weeds and grass in the mid-ground. (3) The camera zooms in on a man in dark clothing operating a small piece of machinery that has been rigged with a large black mesh sail supported by a crude wooden mast. The setup strikingly resembles a ship. A skull and crossbones emoji is edited onto the sail. Another person stands nearby in the dense vegetation as the city skyscrapers tower behind them.
